liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Starts with a Bo Diddley rhythm to signal the song's arrival [5]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Listener realized something significant was happening halfway through the performance [5]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-12-31.pre-fm-sbd.winters.18524.shnf** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 23 songs; 194 min [1]
- **gd1976-12-31.152247.aud.petrunis.flac2448**: audience recording; 22 songs; 188 min [2]
- **gd1976-12-31.fm.hollister.15114.shnf**: FM broadcast; 21 songs; 192 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Phil sounds thundering in the mix during the over-the-top closer; A sub-second dropout occurs near the start of the FM recording [3][9]
- **gd1976-12-31.fm.ksan.3863.shnf**: FM broadcast; 21 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Instruments have good separation while the band plays the song hard [6]

## Around the show

- Band members agreed on the song choice during the micro drums section [6]
- Graham rode a float as Father Time; balloons dropped behind the band [7]
- Jim Haynie and Ken Kesey jumped onto the stage to dance [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-12-31.pre-fm-sbd.winters.18524.shnf**: source: PreFMR (KSAN) > PCM [1]. Also: Jack Warner seeded the pre-FM SBD transfer to the archive in 2003 [1]
- **gd1976-12-31.152247.aud.petrunis.flac2448**: taped by Concert recording by Rich Petrunis.; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 04/2021; source: Mono Sony hand-held recorder (model unknown) > 3x TDK SD C90's (normal bias). Concert recording by Rich Petrunis, standing center floor about 30 feet out from… [2]. Also: John and Rich Petrunis provided the source tapes for this recording [2]
- **gd1976-12-31.fm.hollister.15114.shnf**: taped by Jay Ashley; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: FM MR>SBM-1>CD>Cool Edit Pro>CD [3]. Also: Reel flips and alternate FM splices occur within the Wharf Rat track [3]
- **gd1976-12-31.fm.ksan.3863.shnf**: transferred by Aaron Farsworth; source: FM-SB (KSAN-FM)>?>CDA [4]
